description: Election Commission - Code of Conduct issued by the Election Commission in Pursuance of Section 8 (8) of the Parliamentary Elections Act. No.01 of 1981
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively concerns electoral processes, specifically the issuance of a Code of Conduct for political parties, independent groups, and candidates by the Election Commission in accordance with the Parliamentary Elections Act. It details rules and regulations governing election campaigns and conduct, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
